dedupe_keys.name: conatel paraguay mobile coverage matrix telecom market workbooks and fm am and tv station maps

description: Paraguay's National Telecommunications Commission publishes indicator workbooks for its national telecommunications plans (2011 to 2015, 2016 to 2020 and 2021 to 2025), which set goals for coverage, penetration and quality. The indicators page links yearly mobile coverage workbooks from 2017 to 2022, a 4G LTE coverage file for 2017 and 2018, a telecom service coverage matrix for 2016 to 2020 and 2023, and a mobile coverage matrix for 2025 published in March 2026. Yearly market workbooks from 2015 to 2025 give subscribers, traffic and other market measures, the latest version published in May 2026. A separate page links public web maps, built on uMap and OpenStreetMap, of FM commercial stations, AM stations, television stations and small and medium coverage FM stations. Coverage: Paraguay; the coverage matrices are expected to list localities or districts served by each operator and technology, which was not checked. Format and access: XLSX downloads and uMap web maps, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: some workbooks are protected; the file structure changes between years; the broadcast maps are layers in a third-party tool and may lack technical parameters. Simulation uses: locality coverage by operator and technology and broadcast station locations for Paraguayan service, warning and hazard exposure models. Related records: the LAC-IX survey and map covers Paraguayan exchange points; the ITU ICT statistics give comparable national series.
licence: not stated (no licence or terms statement on the provider pages read on 2026-09-28)
